about: The site-enrolment and per-network creation-status contract shared by the relayer (test/fixtures) and gas_sponsor (tests/fixtures); change it in both, byte for byte; each side pins its sha256.

supersedes.fund-creation-contract.json rules.slot: one slot per (siteUuid, groupUuid, chainId), for ever

routes.creationStatus: GET /creations/:groupUuid with an optional decimal chainId query

rules.binding: The first claim wins and is permanent; no route rebinds, unbinds, enables creation or changes a limit (D-05).
rules.operatorSite: A non-empty siteUuid in the operator's policy file is the binding; POST /site must match it; a stored binding to another site is ignored (D-20).
rules.groups: An empty policy groups list means every group of the bound site; a non-empty list is an allow-list and other groups get 403 group_not_enrolled (D-06, D-21).
rules.slot: One per siteUuid, groupUuid and chainId, for ever; supersedes rules.slot of fund-creation-contract.json (D-02).
rules.creationStatusDefault: Without chainId the relayer answers for the one network marked for fund creation; more than one marked gives 400 chain_id_required.
rules.outsideSend: Enrolment is outside /send/, so no enrolment answer is a send outcome (TM-284).
rules.policyOff: POST /site answers 403 creation_disabled while the operator's policy is off and binds nothing.
